# Carla Diaz

## Role

Carla is the engineering director who owns the budget, the hiring plan and the yearly roadmap, and she meets each team lead once a week to hear about risks and progress. The follow-up items are tracked in the shared log, reviewed every week, and closed only when the owner confirms the result in writing.
